description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the PayGradeAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It includes multiple test methods to verify API endpoints such as getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete, using data providers for parameterized testing.

classes.name: PayGradeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the PayGradeAPI, testing CRUD operations with data providers.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures before each test, truncating relevant tables and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all pay grades via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll test method, reading from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single pay grade by ID.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getOne test method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new pay grade via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create test method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing pay grade.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update test method.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for the delete test method.
